div.div:
Baseline policy
• Allowed locations (allowed_locations)
• Require tag on resource groups: environment, cost_center, owner (Deny)
• Inherit tag from resource group if missing (Modify, managed identity with Tag Contributor)

div.div:
Regulatory compliance (optional, audit)
• ISO 27001:2013 (enable_iso27001)
• NIS2 (custom/partner initiative, enable_nis2)
• Additional initiatives (compliance_policy_assignments)
Scope selectable with compliance_policy_scope.

div.div:
Custom roles (assignable at Landing Zones)
• Data & AI Data Engineer: ADF, Synapse/Databricks read, Event Hubs, Stream Analytics, lake read/write
• Data & AI Data Scientist: Azure ML jobs/notebooks, Foundry projects, read curated data, query AI Search
• Data & AI ML Engineer: ML workspaces, Foundry deployments/projects, AKS user credentials, ACR
